Name: HCW Function Config Refresh
Description: Refresh Key Vault references on func-site-prod-cus-01 so a freshly seeded secret goes live in seconds instead of on App Service's 24-hour cache cycle. NotActions excludes Microsoft.Web/sites/config/list/action — the action that reads app settings back with their resolved secret values — so this cannot be used to route around the set-only vault role. Consumed by infra/keyvault.tf; created once by the owner because the Terraform identity deliberately lacks Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/write.
